findings.title: Root mutex not re-verified at load or kit-resolution
findings.counterexample: saveShapeValidation has no excludesNode check; ordered if/else skips validation
findings.expected: excludesNode pair rejected at integrity boundary or loudly resolved
findings.actual: crafted both-roots save passes validation; resolveBodyKit silently prefers cuong_chien
findings.rootCause: validator checks ownership/coverage not mutex pairs; purchase seam is the only acquisition path
findings.rejectionReason: strict-version validator intentionally checks shape, not domain invariants; no game path can produce both-roots; consistent with F-PT-C-3 precedent

findings.title: PendingReflect key omits attacker in map key
findings.counterexample: reachable only via thrown fault aborting applyActionImpact mid-queue
findings.expected: entries keyed per holder+attacker or cleared on abort
findings.actual: key omits attacker; stale entry could merge a different attacker's hits (timing only)
findings.rootCause: no early return between queue site and flushReflects in normal flow
findings.rejectionReason: requires a thrown fault mid-apply; unreachable via normal flow

findings.title: sourceMaxHpRatio dead field on non-physical authored deal_damage ops (validates, spreads, silently drops)

findings.title: sacrificeMaxHpRatio/damageBonusPerPaidHpPoint on a damage===undefined def drops silently
findings.counterexample: both the pay_hp emit and the orphan report live inside `if (def.damage !== undefined)` - no else branch

findings.title: INV-9 natural-action-source predicate duplicated inline at three+ seams
findings.counterexample: `declared.actionSource === 'normal' || 'skill'` (and negations) written inline at TBS:657, TBS:2433, TBS:3006/3034/3103, TurnSkillPlanRuntime:569
findings.expected: a single named classifier shared by the windows
findings.actual: consistent today, but a future natural source kind needs three+ coordinated edits
findings.rootCause: two-member allowlist inlined at every seam
findings.repair: isNaturalActionSource classifier replaces all inline allowlists @710d8012

findings.title: Pha Kinh bake replaces kit.basic.instances instead of merging
findings.counterexample: plain `=` assignment on the clone, no pre-check
findings.expected: merge with or assert-absent a pre-existing instances block
findings.actual: CUONG_QUYEN has no instances today so nothing is lost, but a future instances-bearing basic would silently lose it
findings.repair: instances bake merges authored block instead of replacing @710d8012

findings.title: corrupt both-roots-owned state silently resolves to cuong kit
findings.counterexample: resolveBodyKit checks cuong_chien before tran_the; a both-owned state picks cuong silently while tran minors remain purchasable dead nodes
findings.expected: impossible both-roots state fails loud or the excluded branch is inert
findings.actual: silent resolution; unreachable via legit flows (excludesNode + orphan cascade + shape validation)
findings.rootCause: no save-level check on the root pair (crafted-save only)
findings.rejectionReason: unreachable via gameplay - purchase excludesNode, respec/devReset orphan cascade, and shape validation all permit at most one owned root; only hand-crafted saves reach it (F-PT-C-3 precedent)

findings.title: TheTuTreePanel isAbandoned() omits stateVersion touch unlike sibling accessors
findings.counterexample: isAbandoned reads getNodeLevel without stateVersion.value while chosenRootId/tcReached/nodeState all touch it
findings.expected: consistent explicit reactivity dependency across accessors
findings.actual: harmless today (chosenRootId tracks the same keys) but divergent convention

findings.title: save version not re-bumped across the node-tree redesign - v84 the-tu saves die as 'corrupted' instead of 'incompatible'
findings.counterexample: v84 save with old-tree the-tu investment passes the version check then fails D9f/catalog validation as 'corrupted'; same-version saves without the-tu load fine
findings.expected: a redesign retiring persisted node ids and re-parenting grants bumps CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION per project convention (v73-v84)
findings.actual: v84 unchanged - asymmetric rejection channel within one version

findings.title: Loan Dau cast at exactly 1 HP commits with zero sacrifice
findings.counterexample: paid = min(maxHp*0.3, 1-1) = 0 -> skip -> cast fires all hits at base coefficient + max missing-HP bonus
findings.expected: design ruling: either gated below 2 HP or intentionally free
findings.actual: free cast at maximum missing-HP state
findings.rootCause: sacrifice is a cost not a gate; spec floor semantics imply pay-what-you-can
findings.rejectionReason: spec 2.3 floor semantics already pin pay-what-you-can (paid<=0 skips, cast commits); 1-HP free-cast edge now pinned in spec 2.3 addendum as intentional for beta - gating below 2 HP is a BETA-BALANCE ruling for the user

findings.title: chan_an per_target+latest ownership shadows an earlier phan_chan holder's mark
findings.counterexample: second phan_chan source's chan_an re-application replaces the first source's instance - first holder's reflect falls to base ratio
findings.expected: marked-ratio check reads this holder's own mark
findings.actual: latest-wins ownership; unreachable in single-player builds (one participant carries phan_chan)
findings.rejectionReason: unreachable in current single-player builds - only one participant can carry phan_chan; flagged for future multi-holder case
